verdict.rationale: Cake documents an MCP connection for AI assistants that is explicitly read-only, but there is no evidence of an API credential system, key/token issuance, or configurable least-privilege scopes for agents — the read-only MCP restriction is a blanket product behavior, not a user-issuable scoped credential. Missing for 10: any mention of API keys/tokens, credential scoping UI, or per-agent permission configuration.
